newsitem.title: USA: Destron implantable chip injunction upheld.
newsitem.headline: Destron implantable chip injunction upheld.

text.p: Destron Fearing Corp said Wednesday that the U.S. Court of Appeals denied a request to stay an injunction that prevents sale of implantable microchips by four Destron competitors.
The injunction was originally issued in April by the U.S. District Court in Denver following a trial in which the four defendants were found to have infringed Destron's patents.
That verdict has been appealed by the defendants, Electronic Identification Devices Ltd, InfoPet Identification Systems Edward Pechacek and Trovan Ltd.
Destron Fearing manufactures electronic and visual identification devices for companion animals, livestock, laboratory animals, fish and wildlife.
